name: crypto-lib-oid-and-version-dotted-quads
note: A crypto/PKI library that references X.509/ASN.1 OIDs ('1.3.101.112' Ed25519, '2.5.29.14' subject-key-id) and a four-part version string. These are dotted quads with octets <=255, so they matched the hardcoded-public-IP heuristic and false-blocked crypto packages (ssh2-streams, pdfkit's cert code), build schemas (app-builder-lib) and compilers (@babel/standalone) whenever the file also had any exec/network capability. A bare quoted dotted-quad now counts as an exfil IP only in a network context (host/connect/socket/URL/port); an OID/version has none. A real quoted IP in a host field still blocks. Regression guard for the deeper-corpus false-block fixes.
